name: Team Player
source: Adventurer's Guide pg. 42, Spymaster's Handbook pg. 27
body:
Team Player (Ex)
Source Adventurer's Guide pg. 42, Spymaster's Handbook pg. 27
The vigilante gains Swift AidAPG as a bonus feat, ignoring its prerequisites. Additionally, the vigilante can use the feat as a standard action, in which case it applies to every ally adjacent to the vigilante. At 10th level, the vigilante can increase the bonus provided to one ally by this feat to +2 by using the aid another action as a move action rather than as a swift action.
